Optimized 3D round-2 lower action is only partially visible at the vertical body scroll boundary; reachability is not established.
3D table/card artwork is visibly coarser than crisp interface text; no renderer-density cause or physical-device quality is established.
Public challenge proof remains separate from private-hand exposure. Native ordinary/Godot outcomes and explicit optimized renderer-death skips are preserved separately from pixel findings.
limits: Only the 14 listed originals were directly viewed. Reviewed identical bytes share pixel observations without merging source identities.
No repeated views, image transforms, app runs, captures or video decodes were performed.
No spoken accessibility, touch behavior, scroll reachability, continuous privacy, clock alignment or shipping qualification is inferred.
